invariants.rationale: instantTime is a String parameter, and methods on it will likely be called, so it should be non-null.
preppedRecordInputs is expected to be a valid list of records; methods that follow would assume it is non-null.
fileGroupsIdsToUpdate needs to be non-null as it represents file groups being modified.
writeClient is likely essential for performing any upsert or commit operation.
The size of a collection is always non-negative; checking isEmpty is valid on a non-null list.
